message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Three new vulnerabilities credibly matching the monitored product list were published in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-10 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-11 23:40 UTC (2026-08-11 05:10 IST through 2026-08-12 05:10 IST).

**Finding 1**

- **Affected product/component:** Zoom Workplace, Zoom Workplace VDI Client, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Meeting SDK
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-53413 — annotator buffer overwrite
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 8.3
- **Description:** A missing bounds check in Zoom's annotation function may let one meeting participant remotely execute code on another participant's client over the network.
- **Why it is relevant:** Zoom is explicitly monitored, and the vendor bulletin names supported Zoom Workplace clients and related official components.
- **Source:** [Zoom Security Bulletin ZSB-26015](https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/security-bulletin/zsb-26015/)

**Finding 2**

- **Affected product/component:** Zoom Workplace, Zoom Workplace VDI Client, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Meeting SDK
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-53414 — annotator buffer over-read
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 score 6.5
- **Description:** A missing bounds check in Zoom's annotation function may let one meeting participant cause a denial of service on another participant's client over the network.
- **Why it is relevant:** Zoom is explicitly monitored, and the vendor bulletin names supported Zoom Workplace clients and related official components.
- **Source:** [Zoom Security Bulletin ZSB-26016](https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/security-bulletin/zsb-26016/)

**Finding 3**

- **Affected product/component:** Zoom Workplace, Zoom Workplace VDI Client, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Meeting SDK
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-53415 — annotator use-after-free
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 8.3
- **Description:** A use-after-free flaw in Zoom's annotation function may let one meeting participant remotely execute code on another participant's client over the network.
- **Why it is relevant:** Zoom is explicitly monitored, and the vendor bulletin names supported Zoom Workplace clients and related official components.
- **Source:** [Zoom Security Bulletin ZSB-26017](https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/security-bulletin/zsb-26017/)

Immediate review is recommended because two of the three vendor-confirmed issues may permit remote code execution between meeting participants. Zoom advises applying the latest available updates. No other fresh advisory in the window could be tied confidently to the monitored products; stale same-day roundup references and loose product-name matches were excluded.
